fact: The CNPA states that the new Code de l'information et de la communication, adopted by Loi n°25-021/AU of 26 December 2025 and promulgated by Décret n°26-023/PR of 2 February 2026, requires explicit labelling of any content generated or heavily modified by AI (article 231), with CNPA sanctions up to 1,000,000 KMF.
